title: Female Warrior with Hammer
description: A fierce young woman with long dark hair stands in a powerful combat stance, holding a massive purple warhammer aloft with one hand. She wears orange and purple tribal-style armor with exposed midriff, matching pants, and boots, her expression intense with bared teeth.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian woman with long flowing black hair and bone hair accessories, standing in a powerful wide stance holding a gigantic ornate purple warhammer high above her head with one hand. She wears orange and purple tribal patterned armor with exposed midriff, wrapped forearms, and matching loose pants with geometric designs. Her expression is aggressive with bared teeth and intense eyes, dramatic lighting, detailed digital fantasy character art on a plain gray background.
